name: outputs-pane
description: Side pane listing files Claude writes, edits or makes with shell commands, split into planning, code, misc and scratch, with a filter and a line saying whether the repo is committed and pushed; click one to open it in your editor or its own app, or in a viewer split when you're in Rex on another machine

editor.title: Editor command
editor.description: Command that opens a clicked file; the path is added as the last argument (e.g. zed, code -r, subl, /usr/local/bin/zed)

scratch.title: Scratch patterns
scratch.description: File names that go in the folded scratch section: comma-separated globs, * and ? as wildcards (e.g. msg-*, *.log); blank for none

markdownViewer.title: Remote markdown viewer
markdownViewer.description: In Rex on another machine, command that shows a clicked planning file in a split; the path is added as the last argument (e.g. glow -p, mdcat --paging)

codeViewer.title: Remote code viewer
codeViewer.description: In Rex on another machine, command that shows a clicked code file in a split; the path is added as the last argument (e.g. bat --paging=always, nvim -R)

miscOpener.title: Misc opener
miscOpener.description: Command that opens a clicked misc file (decks, PDFs, images, video); the path is added as the last argument (e.g. qlmanage -p); blank for open on macOS, xdg-open on Linux

ignore.title: Ignored folders
ignore.description: Folders skipped when listing files a Bash call made, on top of .git, node_modules, target, dist, build and the like: comma-separated globs (e.g. vendor, out*); blank for none

shipIgnore.title: Ship ignore
shipIgnore.description: Branches the ship line leaves out of its unpushed and merged-worktree counts: comma-separated globs (e.g. vendor-*, spike-*); blank for none
